title: Pinning related searches below bottom ads reduced their clicks

change.control: Inline related searches may float above lower-performing algorithmic results.
change.variant: Pin related searches to the bottom, below bottom ads.

quote: on these related searches declined 17%, but the abandonment rate did not change statistically significantly (p-value 0.71)
notes: Over 5 million users. Abandonment p=0.71 applies to abandonment only. Local click loss did not establish a sitewide engagement loss. Full text is also available in the author-hosted PDF at https://exp-platform.com/Documents/2014%20experimentersRulesOfThumb.pdf. The supporting quote and result were checked against that PDF; the equivalent ACM publisher full-text page returned HTTP 403 in Chromium.
